speaker: Doctor
text: I need to start by understanding the severity of your condition. Can you tell me exactly what symptoms you are experiencing right now, and when did they first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient's roommates report that he has been displaying increasingly aggressive and unusual behavior. They mention that he has been under significant stress due to final exams and has become more reclusive. Earlier this evening, he exhibited extreme irritability, yelled at his computer, broke it, and then spent several hours at the gym.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Serotonin Syndrome.

Your history of intense exercise at the gym combined with recent academic stress and behavioral changes suggests a potential interaction between stimulant use and stress-induced autonomic dysregulation. I need to confirm if you have taken any medications, supplements, or recreational drugs recently, and check your vital signs for hyperthermia and tachycardia. REQUEST TEST: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, CBC, and Urinalysis for toxicology screen. REQUEST IMAGES: Vital signs monitoring strip.
